results.title: Federal election monitors won’t enter Indiana polling sites, officials say
results.description: Two-dozen federal Department of Justice monitors will observe Election Day voting — and conduct voluntary exit interviews — in two Indiana counties from outside the polling locations, election officials said Wednesday.
